title: Keyoxide instance directory
description: The list of Keyoxide deployments and the operator keys that claim them.

$schema.description: Editor hint; points at this file.

instance.description: The Keyoxide deployment this operator claims. Must match the notation on their key.

signature.description: Base64 of a detached OpenPGP signature by this key over "keyoxide-directory listing v1\ninstance=<instance>\n". The operator asking to be listed; checked by `npm run verify:entries`, never by the page.

hkpEntry.description: A key looked up on keys.openpgp.org by fingerprint.

fingerprint.description: Long key id (16 hex) or full fingerprint (40 hex). Short key ids are rejected as collision-prone.

wkdEntry.description: A key looked up in the domain's Web Key Directory. Carries the hashed local part, never the address itself.

domain.description: The domain half of the operator's address, which WKD needs in the clear to build a URL.

hash.description: The z-base-32 SHA-1 of the lowercased local part. Compute it with `npm run wkd-hash <address>`.

entry.description: An entry names the lookup it wants: hkp for the keyserver, wkd for a Web Key Directory.
